name: gatefall-mobile
description: Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store) builds of Gatefall, made with Capacitor 8.

scripts.android: npm run web && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run web:ios && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run web && cap run android
scripts.bundle: npm run web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
